free_tier.stated: No free plan. Pro at USD 50/month, with up to 6,000 requests per 5 hours, 45,000 per week and 90,000 per month. The Lite plan stopped accepting new subscriptions on 2026-03-20 and renewals/upgrades on 2026-04-13.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a subscription meters usage, not objects

retention.stated: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference; no caller-stored bytes

egress.terms: not applicable: the vendor serves the inference

tooling: OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible keys; Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Cline, Qwen Code, Codex and OpenClaw are named
chaining: a fixed monthly plan key spent through the plan-specific base URL; only interactive tool use is allowed, so scripted chaining draws pay-as-you-go charges instead

limits.value: unpublished concurrency and per-account rate limits plus queueing under load

identity_cost.detail: an Alibaba Cloud account (or a RAM user granted permission by the account owner); no card or phone requirement for the account is stated on this page; the Pro plan itself is paid

reliability_note: slots are limited and restocked daily at 00:00 UTC+8; technical rate limits may queue or briefly interrupt heavy accounts

evidence.proved: Pro is priced at USD 50 per month with a 6,000-request per 5-hour quota
the 5-hour, weekly and monthly request caps are stated together

evidence.quote: As of March 20, 2026, 00:00:00 (UTC+08:00), the Lite plan is no longer available for new subscriptions
